Area coefficients are L_A/2 and (L_K+L_B/2)/4. The three-site hull has only −1,0,1 sampled bases and its anchored middle inclusion is enforced by construction.

At scalar middle level s the outer thresholds are 2s−h_i and h_i, so old threshold slope is −(2σ_A+σ_K). A fixed disk around y_0 gives a strict slope lower bound and a common enclosing disk the upper bound. The sum of the three local inverse thresholds has its unique zero at Q+O(ε).

The two proper intersections with added bands give the stated uniform first-order cap terms, with O(ε²) transverse mismatch or no mismatch in the separated parallel case. Reciprocal slopes cancel the mark term by normal balance.
